purpose: Determine whether the finite-window TSLS and Robust SIV comparison depends materially on the simulation target or on the target used to construct the restricted-panel outcome GFE template.

empirical_targets.source: Exact restricted-panel TSLS point estimate recomputed from data/panel_lag2.csv.
Arithmetic midpoint of the exact restricted-panel TSLS and Robust SIV point estimates.
Exact restricted-panel Robust SIV point estimate recomputed from data/panel_lag2.csv.

anchor_modes.fixed_template: Hold the baseline midpoint-derived treatment and outcome GFE templates fixed while changing only the structural simulation target in the generated outcome.
anchor_modes.reanchored_template: For each target, recompute the restricted-panel outcome residual Y minus tau W, remove state and year means, extract the rank-two SVD template, and apply the unchanged outcome-component scale.

numerical_equivalence.rule: Require absolute difference to be no greater than the absolute tolerance plus the relative tolerance times the absolute reference value.
